integrator: scipy solve_ivp BDF, analytic sparse Jacobian, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-10, max_step=0.5
wavelength_measure: 2 x mean spacing of successive zeros, pooled over G,X,Y, excluding the core-to-first-ring spacing, zeros with r < 0.6 R
notes: 1D solved on symmetric half-line [0,50] with zero-flux at 0; equivalent to [-50,50] for the symmetric seed.
